# Icon Generation Instructions

## Quick Start

If you have `clyp-icon.png` in this directory, run:

```bash
npm run generate-icons
```

This will automatically:
1. Install the `sharp` image processing library (if needed)
2. Generate all tray icons for macOS, Windows, and Linux
3. Create app icons in various sizes for electron-builder
4. Output a 1024x1024 icon.png for builds

## Generated Files

### Tray Icons (System Tray/Menu Bar)
- `trayTemplate.png` (16x16) - macOS
- `trayTemplate@2x.png` (32x32) - macOS retina
- `tray-windows.png` (16x16) - Windows
- `tray-windows@2x.png` (32x32) - Windows high-DPI
- `tray-linux.png` (16x16) - Linux
- `tray-linux@2x.png` (32x32) - Linux high-DPI

### App Icons (For Distribution)
- `icon.png` (1024x1024) - Main icon for electron-builder
- `icon-16x16.png` through `icon-1024x1024.png` - Various sizes

### Build Artifacts (Auto-generated by electron-builder)
When you run `npm run build`, electron-builder will automatically create:
- `icon.icns` - macOS application icon
- `icon.ico` - Windows application icon

## Manual Icon Creation

If you prefer to create icons manually:

### 1. Prepare Source Icon
- Create a 1024x1024 PNG file with transparent background
- Name it `clyp-icon.png`
- Place it in this directory

### 2. Use Online Tools
- [Icon Generator](https://icon.kitchen/)
- [App Icon Generator](https://www.appicon.co/)
- [electron-icon-builder](https://www.npmjs.com/package/electron-icon-builder)

### 3. Command Line Tools

Using ImageMagick:
```bash
# Tray icons
convert clyp-icon.png -resize 16x16 trayTemplate.png
convert clyp-icon.png -resize 32x32 trayTemplate@2x.png
convert clyp-icon.png -resize 16x16 tray-windows.png
convert clyp-icon.png -resize 32x32 tray-windows@2x.png
convert clyp-icon.png -resize 16x16 tray-linux.png
convert clyp-icon.png -resize 32x32 tray-linux@2x.png

# App icon
convert clyp-icon.png -resize 1024x1024 icon.png
```

## Design Guidelines

### Tray Icons
- **Size**: 16x16 base size (32x32 for retina/high-DPI)
- **Style**: Simple, recognizable at small sizes
- **macOS**: Use monochrome with transparency (system will colorize)
- **Windows/Linux**: Can use full color
- **Format**: PNG with transparency

### App Icons
- **Size**: 1024x1024 recommended source
- **Style**: Match your brand colors (#4A90E2, #50E3C2)
- **Format**: PNG with transparency
- **Content**: The clipboard design with clear edges

## Current Icon

The current `clyp-icon.png` represents a clipboard, matching the Clyp brand:
- Primary color: #4A90E2 (blue)
- Clean, modern design
- Recognizable at all sizes

## Troubleshooting

### Icons not showing in app
- Restart the app after generating new icons
- Check that PNG files exist in this directory
- Look for console warnings about missing icons

### Build fails with icon errors
- Ensure `icon.png` (1024x1024) exists
- For macOS: May need Xcode command line tools
- For Windows: electron-builder handles .ico conversion

### Tray icon looks blurry
- Make sure @2x versions exist for retina displays
- Verify icons are exactly 16x16 and 32x32
- Check that PNG has proper transparency

## Scripts

- `npm run generate-icons` - Generate all icons from clyp-icon.png
- `npm run build` - Build distributable apps (includes icon conversion)
